dialogue.text: Oh
dialogue.zh: 哦
dialogue.ja: ああ
dialogue.local: Oh
dialogue.en: Oh

dialogue.text: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了自然界的變化規律，包括氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化のパターン、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を観察しました。
dialogue.local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運行劃分為24個節氣，用來指導古代中國的農業。
dialogue.ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを測定し、24の節気に分けました。これが古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
dialogue.local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍然指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は数億人の中国人の生活や伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: On or around the 7th of November each year, China ushers in the first solar term of winter, Lead On.
dialogue.zh: 每年11月7日左右，中國迎來冬季的第一個節氣——立冬。
dialogue.ja: 毎年11月7日前後、中国は冬の最初の節気「立冬」を迎えます。
dialogue.local: On or around the 7th of November each year, China ushers in the first solar term of winter, Lead On.
dialogue.en: On or around the 7th of November each year, China ushers in the first solar term of winter, Lead On.

dialogue.text: At this time of year, the water is icing over and the ground starts freezing.
dialogue.zh: 這個時節，水面開始結冰，土地開始凍結。
dialogue.ja: この時期、水は氷が張り始め、地面は凍り始めます。
dialogue.local: At this time of year, the water is icing over and the ground starts freezing.
dialogue.en: At this time of year, the water is icing over and the ground starts freezing.

dialogue.text: It's the season for harvesting, offering sacrifices and celebrating with banquets and the particles.
dialogue.zh: 這是收穫、祭祀和舉行宴會慶祝的季節。
dialogue.ja: 収穫や祭祀、宴会で祝う季節です。
dialogue.local: It's the season for harvesting, offering sacrifices and celebrating with banquets and the particles.
dialogue.en: It's the season for harvesting, offering sacrifices and celebrating with banquets and the particles.

dialogue.text: The start of winter, Lead On, is the 19th solar term of the 24.
dialogue.zh: 立冬是24節氣中的第19個節氣。
dialogue.ja: 立冬は24節気のうちの19番目です。
dialogue.local: The start of winter, Lead On, is the 19th solar term of the 24.
dialogue.en: The start of winter, Lead On, is the 19th solar term of the 24.

dialogue.text: The Chinese character Lead means begin.
dialogue.zh: 中文裡，立字的意思是開始。
dialogue.ja: 中国語の「立」という漢字は「始まり」を意味します。
dialogue.local: The Chinese character Lead means begin.
dialogue.en: The Chinese character Lead means begin.

dialogue.text: Lead On is the day when people in China welcome in the winter season, come what may.
dialogue.zh: 立冬是中國人迎接冬季的日子，無論如何都要迎接冬天。
dialogue.ja: 立冬は中国の人々が冬の季節を迎える日です、何があっても冬を迎えます。
dialogue.local: Lead On is the day when people in China welcome in the winter season, come what may.
dialogue.en: Lead On is the day when people in China welcome in the winter season, come what may.

dialogue.text: Ancient China was a traditional farming society.
dialogue.zh: 古代中國是一個傳統的農業社會。
dialogue.ja: 古代中国は伝統的な農耕社会でした。
dialogue.local: Ancient China was a traditional farming society.
dialogue.en: Ancient China was a traditional farming society.

dialogue.text: In spring, summer and autumn, the farmers work hard.
dialogue.zh: 春夏秋三季，農民們辛勤勞作。
dialogue.ja: 春、夏、秋の間、農民たちは一生懸命働きます。
dialogue.local: In spring, summer and autumn, the farmers work hard.
dialogue.en: In spring, summer and autumn, the farmers work hard.

dialogue.text: In winter, as long as the storm is stopped to the brim with rain, the family just has to keep warm and wait for the new year to arrive.
dialogue.zh: 冬天，只要風暴停止，家人只需保暖，等待新年的到來。
dialogue.ja: 冬には、嵐が止み雨が満ちている限り、家族は暖かくして新年を待つだけです。
dialogue.local: In winter, as long as the storm is stopped to the brim with rain, the family just has to keep warm and wait for the new year to arrive.
dialogue.en: In winter, as long as the storm is stopped to the brim with rain, the family just has to keep warm and wait for the new year to arrive.

dialogue.text: At the start of winter in northern China, nothing grows in the forests and fields.
dialogue.zh: 在中國北方的立冬時節，森林和田野中沒有任何植物生長。
dialogue.ja: 中国北部の立冬の始まりには、森や畑で何も育ちません。
dialogue.local: At the start of winter in northern China, nothing grows in the forests and fields.
dialogue.en: At the start of winter in northern China, nothing grows in the forests and fields.

dialogue.text: Crop fields lie dormant and the ground is left to slowly freeze.
dialogue.zh: 農田休耕，土地慢慢結冰。
dialogue.ja: 作物の畑は休眠し、地面はゆっくりと凍っていきます。
dialogue.local: Crop fields lie dormant and the ground is left to slowly freeze.
dialogue.en: Crop fields lie dormant and the ground is left to slowly freeze.

dialogue.text: In the fairly warm south, a new sport crops up in early winter, winter swimming.
dialogue.zh: 在較溫暖的南方，初冬出現了一項新運動——冬泳。
dialogue.ja: 比較的暖かい南部では、初冬に新しいスポーツ、冬泳が現れます。
dialogue.local: In the fairly warm south, a new sport crops up in early winter, winter swimming.
dialogue.en: In the fairly warm south, a new sport crops up in early winter, winter swimming.

dialogue.text: Shaoxing Province is a city moistened by the lake it surrounds, homes on the shore house the locals.
dialogue.zh: 紹興省是一座被湖泊環繞的城市，湖岸的房屋是當地居民的家。
dialogue.ja: 紹興省は湖に囲まれた都市で、湖の岸辺の家々には地元の人々が住んでいます。
dialogue.local: Shaoxing Province is a city moistened by the lake it surrounds, homes on the shore house the locals.
dialogue.en: Shaoxing Province is a city moistened by the lake it surrounds, homes on the shore house the locals.

dialogue.text: Dignon Falls like in retirement is much like that of many older people in China today.
dialogue.zh: 丁侖的退休生活與現今許多中國老年人的生活相似。
dialogue.ja: 丁侖の引退後の生活は、今日の多くの中国の高齢者の生活に似ています。
dialogue.local: Dignon Falls like in retirement is much like that of many older people in China today.
dialogue.en: Dignon Falls like in retirement is much like that of many older people in China today.

dialogue.text: Flying food, cooking, picking up the grandkids from the school.
dialogue.zh: 買菜、做飯、接孫子放學。
dialogue.ja: 食材を買い、料理をし、孫を学校から迎えに行きます。
dialogue.local: Flying food, cooking, picking up the grandkids from the school.
dialogue.en: Flying food, cooking, picking up the grandkids from the school.

dialogue.text: But aside from all that, the Jin couple have a special hobby in common, winter swimming.
dialogue.zh: 但除此之外，金氏夫婦有一個共同的特殊愛好——冬泳。
dialogue.ja: しかしそれ以外に、金さん夫妻には共通の特別な趣味があります。それは冬泳です。
dialogue.local: But aside from all that, the Jin couple have a special hobby in common, winter swimming.
dialogue.en: But aside from all that, the Jin couple have a special hobby in common, winter swimming.

dialogue.text: They do this every single morning, Old Jin has even turned his hobby into a post-retirement career.
dialogue.zh: 他們每天早晨都會這樣做，老金甚至將這個愛好變成了退休後的事業。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは毎朝これを行い、老金さんは趣味を退職後の仕事にまでしています。
dialogue.local: They do this every single morning, Old Jin has even turned his hobby into a post-retirement career.
dialogue.en: They do this every single morning, Old Jin has even turned his hobby into a post-retirement career.

dialogue.text: He is the vice president of the Shaoxing Winter Swimming Association.
dialogue.zh: 他是紹興冬泳協會的副會長。
dialogue.ja: 彼は紹興冬泳協会の副会長です。
dialogue.local: He is the vice president of the Shaoxing Winter Swimming Association.
dialogue.en: He is the vice president of the Shaoxing Winter Swimming Association.

dialogue.text: Winter swimming is swimming outdoors in water that has not been artificially heated.
dialogue.zh: 冬泳是在未經人工加熱的戶外水域游泳。
dialogue.ja: 冬泳とは、人工的に温められていない屋外の水で泳ぐことです。
dialogue.local: Winter swimming is swimming outdoors in water that has not been artificially heated.
dialogue.en: Winter swimming is swimming outdoors in water that has not been artificially heated.

dialogue.text: The air temperature should be below 10 degrees Celsius and the water temperature below 17 degrees Celsius.
dialogue.zh: 空氣溫度應低於10攝氏度，水溫低於17攝氏度。
dialogue.ja: 気温は10度以下、水温は17度以下であるべきです。
dialogue.local: The air temperature should be below 10 degrees Celsius and the water temperature below 17 degrees Celsius.
dialogue.en: The air temperature should be below 10 degrees Celsius and the water temperature below 17 degrees Celsius.

dialogue.text: Dignon, the first air winter, is symbolically the first day of the winter swimming season.
dialogue.zh: 丁侖，立冬，是冬泳季節的象徵性第一天。
dialogue.ja: 丁侖、立冬は冬泳シーズンの象徴的な初日です。
dialogue.local: Dignon, the first air winter, is symbolically the first day of the winter swimming season.
dialogue.en: Dignon, the first air winter, is symbolically the first day of the winter swimming season.

dialogue.text: As a water town, Shaoxing has everything it needs to be a perfect place for winter swimming.
dialogue.zh: 作為水鄉，紹興擁有冬泳所需的一切條件。
dialogue.ja: 水の町として、紹興は冬泳に最適な場所の条件をすべて備えています。
dialogue.local: As a water town, Shaoxing has everything it needs to be a perfect place for winter swimming.
dialogue.en: As a water town, Shaoxing has everything it needs to be a perfect place for winter swimming.

dialogue.text: This year's National Winter Swimming Championships will be held here.
dialogue.zh: 今年的全國冬泳錦標賽將在這裡舉行。
dialogue.ja: 今年の全国冬泳選手権はここで開催されます。
dialogue.local: This year's National Winter Swimming Championships will be held here.
dialogue.en: This year's National Winter Swimming Championships will be held here.

dialogue.text: Old Jin is one of the organizers.
dialogue.zh: 老金是組織者之一。
dialogue.ja: 老金さんは主催者の一人です。
dialogue.local: Old Jin is one of the organizers.
dialogue.en: Old Jin is one of the organizers.

dialogue.text: He leads the daily practice sessions for participants.
dialogue.zh: 他帶領參賽者進行每日練習。
dialogue.ja: 彼は参加者の毎日の練習を指導しています。
dialogue.local: He leads the daily practice sessions for participants.
dialogue.en: He leads the daily practice sessions for participants.

dialogue.text: This entails swimming up and down the Jinful lake.
dialogue.zh: 這包括在金甫湖來回游泳。
dialogue.ja: これは金甫湖を往復して泳ぐことを含みます。
dialogue.local: This entails swimming up and down the Jinful lake.
dialogue.en: This entails swimming up and down the Jinful lake.

dialogue.text: People say the lake has the best water quality and the best environment for winter swimming.
dialogue.zh: 人們說這個湖水質最好，冬泳環境最佳。
dialogue.ja: 人々はこの湖が冬泳に最適な水質と環境を持っていると言います。
dialogue.local: People say the lake has the best water quality and the best environment for winter swimming.
dialogue.en: People say the lake has the best water quality and the best environment for winter swimming.

dialogue.text: Although I am not as crazy about it as Mr. Jin,
dialogue.zh: 雖然我不像金先生那麼熱衷，
dialogue.ja: 私は金さんほど熱狂的ではありませんが、
dialogue.local: Although I am not as crazy about it as Mr. Jin,
dialogue.en: Although I am not as crazy about it as Mr. Jin,

dialogue.text: I do take the occasional dip in Beijing's Houhai lake in the winter.
dialogue.zh: 我偶爾會在北京的後海湖冬泳。
dialogue.ja: 冬には北京の後海湖で時々泳ぎます。
dialogue.local: I do take the occasional dip in Beijing's Houhai lake in the winter.
dialogue.en: I do take the occasional dip in Beijing's Houhai lake in the winter.

dialogue.text: It's a good exercise for the heart and brain.
dialogue.zh: 這對心臟和大腦都是很好的鍛煉。
dialogue.ja: 心臓と脳の良い運動になります。
dialogue.local: It's a good exercise for the heart and brain.
dialogue.en: It's a good exercise for the heart and brain.

dialogue.text: When stimulated by cold water, your blood vessels expand and contract.
dialogue.zh: 當冷水刺激時，血管會擴張和收縮。
dialogue.ja: 冷たい水に刺激されると、血管が拡張と収縮を繰り返します。
dialogue.local: When stimulated by cold water, your blood vessels expand and contract.
dialogue.en: When stimulated by cold water, your blood vessels expand and contract.

dialogue.text: After a workout like this, they can take anything.
dialogue.zh: 經過這樣的鍛煉後，血管能承受任何挑戰。
dialogue.ja: このような運動の後、血管はどんなことにも耐えられます。
dialogue.local: After a workout like this, they can take anything.
dialogue.en: After a workout like this, they can take anything.

dialogue.text: You can feel your circulation and metabolism getting stronger.
dialogue.zh: 你會感覺到血液循環和新陳代謝變得更強。
dialogue.ja: 血液循環と代謝が強くなっているのを感じられます。
dialogue.local: You can feel your circulation and metabolism getting stronger.
dialogue.en: You can feel your circulation and metabolism getting stronger.

dialogue.text: If you get to swim in the early morning in winter, it will put you in a good mood all day.
dialogue.zh: 如果你能在冬天清晨游泳，整天心情都會很好。
dialogue.ja: 冬の早朝に泳ぐと、一日中気分が良くなります。
dialogue.local: If you get to swim in the early morning in winter, it will put you in a good mood all day.
dialogue.en: If you get to swim in the early morning in winter, it will put you in a good mood all day.

dialogue.text: A bit like drinking, a really good cup of coffee.
dialogue.zh: 有點像喝一杯真正好喝的咖啡。
dialogue.ja: 本当に美味しいコーヒーを飲むようなものです。
dialogue.local: A bit like drinking, a really good cup of coffee.
dialogue.en: A bit like drinking, a really good cup of coffee.

dialogue.text: Not only does it give Shaoxing locals a chance to swim in the winter, but it also provides for another favourite winter pastime, deeply connected to local culture.
dialogue.zh: 這不僅讓紹興人有機會冬泳，還提供了另一個深受當地文化喜愛的冬季娛樂活動。
dialogue.ja: これは紹興の人々に冬に泳ぐ機会を与えるだけでなく、地元文化と深く結びついたもう一つの冬の楽しみも提供します。
dialogue.local: Not only does it give Shaoxing locals a chance to swim in the winter, but it also provides for another favourite winter pastime, deeply connected to local culture.
dialogue.en: Not only does it give Shaoxing locals a chance to swim in the winter, but it also provides for another favourite winter pastime, deeply connected to local culture.

dialogue.text: Not far from downtown Shaoxing, there's an ancient part of town built by the water.
dialogue.zh: 離紹興市中心不遠，有一個古老的水鄉城區。
dialogue.ja: 紹興の中心街から遠くない場所に、水辺に建てられた古い町があります。
dialogue.local: Not far from downtown Shaoxing, there's an ancient part of town built by the water.
dialogue.en: Not far from downtown Shaoxing, there's an ancient part of town built by the water.

dialogue.text: And in winter, the air here is thick with wine.
dialogue.zh: 冬天，這裡的空氣中彌漫著濃濃的酒香。
dialogue.ja: 冬になると、ここでは酒の香りが濃厚に漂います。
dialogue.local: And in winter, the air here is thick with wine.
dialogue.en: And in winter, the air here is thick with wine.

dialogue.text: When winter comes, Shaoxing's special yellow rice wine is brewed.
dialogue.zh: 冬天來臨時，紹興特有的黃酒開始釀造。
dialogue.ja: 冬が来ると、紹興の特別な黄酒が醸造されます。
dialogue.local: When winter comes, Shaoxing's special yellow rice wine is brewed.
dialogue.en: When winter comes, Shaoxing's special yellow rice wine is brewed.

dialogue.text: Some scholars believe that the emergence of wine signified a big change in human civilization.
dialogue.zh: 一些學者認為，酒的出現標誌著人類文明的一大變革。
dialogue.ja: 一部の学者は、酒の誕生が人類文明の大きな変化を意味すると考えています。
dialogue.local: Some scholars believe that the emergence of wine signified a big change in human civilization.
dialogue.en: Some scholars believe that the emergence of wine signified a big change in human civilization.

dialogue.text: In the end of food scarcity and the beginning of human socialization.
dialogue.zh: 這代表著食物匱乏的結束和人類社會化的開始。
dialogue.ja: 食料不足の終わりと人間の社会化の始まりを意味します。
dialogue.local: In the end of food scarcity and the beginning of human socialization.
dialogue.en: In the end of food scarcity and the beginning of human socialization.

dialogue.text: The history of the yellow wine they make here in Shaoxing is very rich.
dialogue.zh: 紹興黃酒的歷史非常悠久。
dialogue.ja: 紹興で作られる黄酒の歴史は非常に豊かです。
dialogue.local: The history of the yellow wine they make here in Shaoxing is very rich.
dialogue.en: The history of the yellow wine they make here in Shaoxing is very rich.

dialogue.text: It can be traced back to 2500 years ago.
dialogue.zh: 可以追溯到2500年前。
dialogue.ja: それは2500年前に遡ることができます。
dialogue.local: It can be traced back to 2500 years ago.
dialogue.en: It can be traced back to 2500 years ago.

dialogue.text: The wet, stable environment and the clear water of the gentle lake play their part.
dialogue.zh: 濕潤穩定的環境和清澈的湖水起了重要作用。
dialogue.ja: 湿潤で安定した環境と穏やかな湖の澄んだ水が役割を果たしています。
dialogue.local: The wet, stable environment and the clear water of the gentle lake play their part.
dialogue.en: The wet, stable environment and the clear water of the gentle lake play their part.

dialogue.text: It makes sense to begin the wine making process in winter.
dialogue.zh: 在冬天開始釀酒過程是合理的。
dialogue.ja: 冬に醸造を始めるのは理にかなっています。
dialogue.local: It makes sense to begin the wine making process in winter.
dialogue.en: It makes sense to begin the wine making process in winter.

dialogue.text: The water is particularly clear then.
dialogue.zh: 那時水特別清澈。
dialogue.ja: その時期の水は特に澄んでいます。
dialogue.local: The water is particularly clear then.
dialogue.en: The water is particularly clear then.

dialogue.text: The low temperatures limit the growth of bacteria, so fermentation can go ahead according to plan.
dialogue.zh: 低溫限制細菌生長，發酵可以按計劃進行。
dialogue.ja: 低温は細菌の増殖を抑え、発酵が計画通りに進みます。
dialogue.local: The low temperatures limit the growth of bacteria, so fermentation can go ahead according to plan.
dialogue.en: The low temperatures limit the growth of bacteria, so fermentation can go ahead according to plan.

dialogue.text: And long fermentation at lower temperatures is best for flavour.
dialogue.zh: 低溫長時間發酵對風味最好。
dialogue.ja: 低温での長時間発酵が風味に最適です。
dialogue.local: And long fermentation at lower temperatures is best for flavour.
dialogue.en: And long fermentation at lower temperatures is best for flavour.

dialogue.text: At the beginning of the wine making season, wine makers use the late water flowing past their door, carefully cleaning the various tools used in the brewing process.
dialogue.zh: 釀酒季開始時，釀酒師利用門前流過的晚水，仔細清洗釀造工具。
dialogue.ja: 醸造シーズンの初めに、醸造者は家の前を流れる遅い水を使い、醸造に使う様々な道具を丁寧に洗います。
dialogue.local: At the beginning of the wine making season, wine makers use the late water flowing past their door, carefully cleaning the various tools used in the brewing process.
dialogue.en: At the beginning of the wine making season, wine makers use the late water flowing past their door, carefully cleaning the various tools used in the brewing process.

dialogue.text: And cover the pots for their new wine with a layer of antibacterial lime water.
dialogue.zh: 並用一層抗菌的石灰水覆蓋新酒的容器。
dialogue.ja: そして新しい酒の壺を抗菌性の石灰水の層で覆います。
dialogue.local: And cover the pots for their new wine with a layer of antibacterial lime water.
dialogue.en: And cover the pots for their new wine with a layer of antibacterial lime water.

dialogue.text: Origin tells me this town is where Chinese rice wine began.
dialogue.zh: 據說這個鎮是中國黃酒的發源地。
dialogue.ja: 伝承によると、この町は中国の黄酒の発祥地です。
dialogue.local: Origin tells me this town is where Chinese rice wine began.
dialogue.en: Origin tells me this town is where Chinese rice wine began.

dialogue.text: In the Song Dynasty a thousand years ago, there were more than 500 wineries at one point.
dialogue.zh: 宋朝時期，這裡一度有超過500家酒廠。
dialogue.ja: 1000年前の宋代には、一時期500以上の酒造所がありました。
dialogue.local: In the Song Dynasty a thousand years ago, there were more than 500 wineries at one point.
dialogue.en: In the Song Dynasty a thousand years ago, there were more than 500 wineries at one point.

dialogue.text: For thousands of years, people in Jiangsu and Zhou Dian got married, had kids, moved home, celebrated old age, and on every occasion, they came laden with a jug of rice wine.
dialogue.zh: 數千年來，江蘇和周邊地區的人們結婚、生子、搬家、慶祝長壽，每逢重要場合都帶著一壺黃酒。
dialogue.ja: 何千年もの間、江蘇や周辺の人々は結婚し、子供を持ち、引っ越し、長寿を祝いました。そしてどんな機会にも米酒の壺を持ってきました。
dialogue.local: For thousands of years, people in Jiangsu and Zhou Dian got married, had kids, moved home, celebrated old age, and on every occasion, they came laden with a jug of rice wine.
dialogue.en: For thousands of years, people in Jiangsu and Zhou Dian got married, had kids, moved home, celebrated old age, and on every occasion, they came laden with a jug of rice wine.

dialogue.text: The fuller the jug, the more intense the emotion.
dialogue.zh: 壺越滿，情感越濃。
dialogue.ja: 壺がいっぱいであればあるほど、感情はより強くなります。
dialogue.local: The fuller the jug, the more intense the emotion.
dialogue.en: The fuller the jug, the more intense the emotion.

dialogue.text: The key to the quality of the rice wine is the yeast.
dialogue.zh: 黃酒品質的關鍵是酵母。
dialogue.ja: 米酒の品質の鍵は酵母です。
dialogue.local: The key to the quality of the rice wine is the yeast.
dialogue.en: The key to the quality of the rice wine is the yeast.

dialogue.text: This is the essence of Chinese wine making.
dialogue.zh: 這是中國釀酒的精髓。
dialogue.ja: これが中国の醸造の本質です。
dialogue.local: This is the essence of Chinese wine making.
dialogue.en: This is the essence of Chinese wine making.

dialogue.text: It derived from grain milieu.
dialogue.zh: 它來自穀物的環境。
dialogue.ja: それは穀物の環境から生まれました。
dialogue.local: It derived from grain milieu.
dialogue.en: It derived from grain milieu.

dialogue.text: The microorganisms in it are some kind of mold or fungus.
dialogue.zh: 其中的微生物是一種黴菌或真菌。
dialogue.ja: その中の微生物は一種のカビや菌類です。
dialogue.local: The microorganisms in it are some kind of mold or fungus.
dialogue.en: The microorganisms in it are some kind of mold or fungus.

dialogue.text: The use of mold is a major invention of the Chinese.
dialogue.zh: 使用黴菌是中國人的一項重大發明。
dialogue.ja: カビの利用は中国人の大きな発明です。
dialogue.local: The use of mold is a major invention of the Chinese.
dialogue.en: The use of mold is a major invention of the Chinese.

dialogue.text: Some say it's comparable to the four great inventions of ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 有人說這可與中國古代四大發明相提並論。
dialogue.ja: それは古代中国の四大発明に匹敵すると言われています。
dialogue.local: Some say it's comparable to the four great inventions of ancient China.
dialogue.en: Some say it's comparable to the four great inventions of ancient China.

dialogue.text: This fragrant sticky rice and water from the lake will change under the implements of this yeast.
dialogue.zh: 這種香糯米和湖水在酵母的作用下會發生變化。
dialogue.ja: この香り高いもち米と湖の水は酵母の働きで変化します。
dialogue.local: This fragrant sticky rice and water from the lake will change under the implements of this yeast.
dialogue.en: This fragrant sticky rice and water from the lake will change under the implements of this yeast.

dialogue.text: They will go on a three-month journey together.
dialogue.zh: 它們將一起經歷三個月的發酵過程。
dialogue.ja: それらは一緒に3か月の旅をします。
dialogue.local: They will go on a three-month journey together.
dialogue.en: They will go on a three-month journey together.

dialogue.text: And when next spring comes, the newly brewed liquor will be taken out to continue its journey, eventually becoming a full-body amber-coloured aged wine.
dialogue.zh: 來年春天，新釀的酒會被取出繼續陳釀，最終成為醇厚的琥珀色陳年黃酒。
dialogue.ja: そして翌春、新しく醸造された酒は取り出され、熟成の旅を続け、最終的に芳醇な琥珀色の熟成酒になります。
dialogue.local: And when next spring comes, the newly brewed liquor will be taken out to continue its journey, eventually becoming a full-body amber-coloured aged wine.
dialogue.en: And when next spring comes, the newly brewed liquor will be taken out to continue its journey, eventually becoming a full-body amber-coloured aged wine.

dialogue.text: In Shaoxing, there is a special rice wine called Red Daughter.
dialogue.zh: 在紹興，有一種特別的黃酒叫做紅姑娘。
dialogue.ja: 紹興には「紅娘」と呼ばれる特別な米酒があります。
dialogue.local: In Shaoxing, there is a special rice wine called Red Daughter.
dialogue.en: In Shaoxing, there is a special rice wine called Red Daughter.

dialogue.text: In ancient times, better off families would make it when a daughter was born.
dialogue.zh: 古時候，富裕家庭會在女兒出生時釀造這種酒。
dialogue.ja: 昔、裕福な家族は娘が生まれたときにこれを作りました。
dialogue.local: In ancient times, better off families would make it when a daughter was born.
dialogue.en: In ancient times, better off families would make it when a daughter was born.

dialogue.text: Her father would take home-grown glutinous rice, make three jugs of yellow wine, and seal them up before burying them in the yard.
dialogue.zh: 父親會用自家種的糯米釀三壺黃酒，封存後埋在院子裡。
dialogue.ja: 父親は自家栽培のもち米を使い、3つの壺に黄酒を作り、封をして庭に埋めました。
dialogue.local: Her father would take home-grown glutinous rice, make three jugs of yellow wine, and seal them up before burying them in the yard.
dialogue.en: Her father would take home-grown glutinous rice, make three jugs of yellow wine, and seal them up before burying them in the yard.

dialogue.text: When the daughter reached 18 and left home to get married, it would be dug out as a dowry.
dialogue.zh: 女兒18歲出嫁時，這些酒會被挖出作為嫁妝。
dialogue.ja: 娘が18歳で嫁ぐときに、それらは持参金として掘り出されました。
dialogue.local: When the daughter reached 18 and left home to get married, it would be dug out as a dowry.
dialogue.en: When the daughter reached 18 and left home to get married, it would be dug out as a dowry.

dialogue.text: The wine symbolizes no less than the love of a father for his daughter.
dialogue.zh: 這酒象徵著父親對女兒深厚的愛。
dialogue.ja: この酒は父親の娘への愛情を象徴しています。
dialogue.local: The wine symbolizes no less than the love of a father for his daughter.
dialogue.en: The wine symbolizes no less than the love of a father for his daughter.

dialogue.text: With the increasing demand for rice wine at the market, Shaoxing has a lot of factories making wine.
dialogue.zh: 隨著市場對黃酒需求增加，紹興有許多酒廠生產黃酒。
dialogue.ja: 市場での米酒の需要が増えるにつれて、紹興には多くの酒造工場があります。
dialogue.local: With the increasing demand for rice wine at the market, Shaoxing has a lot of factories making wine.
dialogue.en: With the increasing demand for rice wine at the market, Shaoxing has a lot of factories making wine.

dialogue.text: Factory production is the main thing, and improved efficiency on the production line has made a big difference to the quality of rice wine.
dialogue.zh: 工廠生產是主要方式，生產線效率提升大大改善了黃酒品質。
dialogue.ja: 工場生産が主流で、生産ラインの効率向上が米酒の品質に大きな影響を与えました。
dialogue.local: Factory production is the main thing, and improved efficiency on the production line has made a big difference to the quality of rice wine.
dialogue.en: Factory production is the main thing, and improved efficiency on the production line has made a big difference to the quality of rice wine.

dialogue.text: These companies now produce more than 440,000 tons of rice wine a year, and your sales have reached a whopping 3.45 billion yen.
dialogue.zh: 這些公司現在每年生產超過44萬噸黃酒，銷售額達到驚人的34.5億日元。
dialogue.ja: これらの会社は現在、年間44万トン以上の米酒を生産し、売上高は驚異の34.5億円に達しています。
dialogue.local: These companies now produce more than 440,000 tons of rice wine a year, and your sales have reached a whopping 3.45 billion yen.
dialogue.en: These companies now produce more than 440,000 tons of rice wine a year, and your sales have reached a whopping 3.45 billion yen.

dialogue.text: No matter how huge the scale of production these days or how advanced the equipment, the quality of Shaoxing rice wine remains tightly controlled.
dialogue.zh: 無論如今生產規模多大，設備多先進，紹興黃酒的品質仍嚴格把控。
dialogue.ja: 現在の生産規模や設備の先進性に関わらず、紹興米酒の品質は厳しく管理されています。
dialogue.local: No matter how huge the scale of production these days or how advanced the equipment, the quality of Shaoxing rice wine remains tightly controlled.
dialogue.en: No matter how huge the scale of production these days or how advanced the equipment, the quality of Shaoxing rice wine remains tightly controlled.

dialogue.text: The temperature at Lead On and the Dignon water quality still determine the taste.
dialogue.zh: 立冬時的溫度和丁侖的水質仍然決定著口感。
dialogue.ja: 立冬の温度と丁侖の水質が味を決定します。
dialogue.local: The temperature at Lead On and the Dignon water quality still determine the taste.
dialogue.en: The temperature at Lead On and the Dignon water quality still determine the taste.

dialogue.text: Wine makers in the factories are all inheritors of techniques developed over the centuries.
dialogue.zh: 工廠裡的釀酒師都是世代相傳技術的繼承者。
dialogue.ja: 工場の醸造者は皆、何世紀にもわたって発展してきた技術の継承者です。
dialogue.local: Wine makers in the factories are all inheritors of techniques developed over the centuries.
dialogue.en: Wine makers in the factories are all inheritors of techniques developed over the centuries.

dialogue.text: Think about it.
dialogue.zh: 想想看。
dialogue.ja: 考えてみてください。
dialogue.local: Think about it.
dialogue.en: Think about it.

dialogue.text: If you live next to such a lake surrounded by water in a city that produces tasty drinks, how would you entertain yourself?
dialogue.zh: 如果你住在這樣一個被水環繞、出產美味飲品的城市旁邊，你會如何娛樂自己？
dialogue.ja: もしあなたが美味しい飲み物を生産する水に囲まれた湖のそばの街に住んでいたら、どうやって楽しみますか？
dialogue.local: If you live next to such a lake surrounded by water in a city that produces tasty drinks, how would you entertain yourself?
dialogue.en: If you live next to such a lake surrounded by water in a city that produces tasty drinks, how would you entertain yourself?

dialogue.text: What Chinese aristocrats came up with a thousand years ago is pretty romantic.
dialogue.zh: 中國貴族一千年前想出的點子相當浪漫。
dialogue.ja: 中国の貴族が1000年前に考え出したことはとてもロマンチックです。
dialogue.local: What Chinese aristocrats came up with a thousand years ago is pretty romantic.
dialogue.en: What Chinese aristocrats came up with a thousand years ago is pretty romantic.

dialogue.text: They call it a two-shrly leo of Shaoxing, a kind of river drinking game.
dialogue.zh: 他們稱之為紹興的曲水流觴，一種河邊飲酒遊戲。
dialogue.ja: それは紹興の「曲水流觴」と呼ばれる川での飲み会ゲームです。
dialogue.local: They call it a two-shrly leo of Shaoxing, a kind of river drinking game.
dialogue.en: They call it a two-shrly leo of Shaoxing, a kind of river drinking game.

dialogue.text: People sit on both sides of the canal, a glass of wine is filled upstream and set to float downstream.
dialogue.zh: 人們坐在運河兩岸，上游放下一杯酒讓它順流而下。
dialogue.ja: 人々は運河の両岸に座り、上流に注がれた酒の杯を下流に流します。
dialogue.local: People sit on both sides of the canal, a glass of wine is filled upstream and set to float downstream.
dialogue.en: People sit on both sides of the canal, a glass of wine is filled upstream and set to float downstream.

dialogue.text: Whoever it stops by or overturns next to has to make up a poem on the spot.
dialogue.zh: 酒杯停靠或翻倒的人必須即興作詩。
dialogue.ja: 杯が止まったりひっくり返った人は、その場で詩を作らなければなりません。
dialogue.local: Whoever it stops by or overturns next to has to make up a poem on the spot.
dialogue.en: Whoever it stops by or overturns next to has to make up a poem on the spot.

dialogue.text: Or they have to drink if they can't think of anything.
dialogue.zh: 如果想不出詩，就得喝酒。
dialogue.ja: 詩が思いつかなければ、飲まなければなりません。
dialogue.local: Or they have to drink if they can't think of anything.
dialogue.en: Or they have to drink if they can't think of anything.

dialogue.text: Such a party would often end in drunkenness, and what we're left with is a stack of the most beautiful heartfelt poetry in China.
dialogue.zh: 這樣的聚會常以醉酒結束，留下的是中國最美麗動人的詩篇。
dialogue.ja: そのような宴会はしばしば酔っぱらいで終わり、私たちに残るのは中国で最も美しい心のこもった詩の数々です。
dialogue.local: Such a party would often end in drunkenness, and what we're left with is a stack of the most beautiful heartfelt poetry in China.
dialogue.en: Such a party would often end in drunkenness, and what we're left with is a stack of the most beautiful heartfelt poetry in China.

dialogue.text: The people here have inherited this romanticism.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的人們繼承了這份浪漫情懷。
dialogue.ja: ここに住む人々はこのロマンチシズムを受け継いでいます。
dialogue.local: The people here have inherited this romanticism.
dialogue.en: The people here have inherited this romanticism.

dialogue.text: It might be 2,500 years old, but Shaoxing wine culture is still going strong.
dialogue.zh: 紹興酒文化已有2500年歷史，但仍然蓬勃發展。
dialogue.ja: 2500年の歴史があるかもしれませんが、紹興の酒文化は今も盛んです。
dialogue.local: It might be 2,500 years old, but Shaoxing wine culture is still going strong.
dialogue.en: It might be 2,500 years old, but Shaoxing wine culture is still going strong.

dialogue.text: The ingredients are pretty ordinary, but the taste is uniquely Shaoxing.
dialogue.zh: 原料很普通，但味道獨特，是紹興風味。
dialogue.ja: 材料はごく普通ですが、味は紹興独特のものです。
dialogue.local: The ingredients are pretty ordinary, but the taste is uniquely Shaoxing.
dialogue.en: The ingredients are pretty ordinary, but the taste is uniquely Shaoxing.

dialogue.text: After visiting the winter brewing scene of Shaoxing, I find winter swimming and rice wine making have pretty much the same purpose.
dialogue.zh: 參觀紹興冬季釀酒場景後，我發現冬泳和釀黃酒的目的非常相似。
dialogue.ja: 紹興の冬の醸造現場を訪れた後、冬泳と米酒作りはほぼ同じ目的を持っていることに気づきました。
dialogue.local: After visiting the winter brewing scene of Shaoxing, I find winter swimming and rice wine making have pretty much the same purpose.
dialogue.en: After visiting the winter brewing scene of Shaoxing, I find winter swimming and rice wine making have pretty much the same purpose.

dialogue.text: Winter swimming is for adapting to changes in season, shifting from summer to autumn to winter in people and in nature.
dialogue.zh: 冬泳是為了適應季節變化，從夏到秋再到冬，無論是人還是自然。
dialogue.ja: 冬泳は季節の変化に適応するためのもので、人間も自然も夏から秋、そして冬へと移り変わります。
dialogue.local: Winter swimming is for adapting to changes in season, shifting from summer to autumn to winter in people and in nature.
dialogue.en: Winter swimming is for adapting to changes in season, shifting from summer to autumn to winter in people and in nature.

dialogue.text: This involves mutual coordination and adaptation.
dialogue.zh: 這涉及相互協調和適應。
dialogue.ja: これは相互の調整と適応を伴います。
dialogue.local: This involves mutual coordination and adaptation.
dialogue.en: This involves mutual coordination and adaptation.

dialogue.text: The same is true of wine making, starting from the beginning of winter, water and glutinous rice are mixed with yeast.
dialogue.zh: 釀酒也是如此，從立冬開始，水和糯米與酵母混合。
dialogue.ja: 醸造も同様で、冬の始まりから水ともち米が酵母と混ぜられます。
dialogue.local: The same is true of wine making, starting from the beginning of winter, water and glutinous rice are mixed with yeast.
dialogue.en: The same is true of wine making, starting from the beginning of winter, water and glutinous rice are mixed with yeast.

dialogue.text: A long coordination and adaptation process take place.
dialogue.zh: 經歷一個長時間的協調和適應過程。
dialogue.ja: 長い調整と適応の過程が行われます。
dialogue.local: A long coordination and adaptation process take place.
dialogue.en: A long coordination and adaptation process take place.

dialogue.text: In spring of the following year, the pulp of the original ingredients has turned into clear sweet wine, and the role of Old Jin, captain of the swimming team, matches that of the yeast in the wine making process.
dialogue.zh: 翌年春天，原料的漿液變成清澈甜酒，游泳隊長老金的角色就像釀酒過程中的酵母一樣。
dialogue.ja: 翌春には原料のパルプが澄んだ甘い酒に変わり、泳ぐチームのキャプテンである老金さんの役割は醸造過程の酵母と一致します。
dialogue.local: In spring of the following year, the pulp of the original ingredients has turned into clear sweet wine, and the role of Old Jin, captain of the swimming team, matches that of the yeast in the wine making process.
dialogue.en: In spring of the following year, the pulp of the original ingredients has turned into clear sweet wine, and the role of Old Jin, captain of the swimming team, matches that of the yeast in the wine making process.

dialogue.text: Passion and energy come together.
dialogue.zh: 熱情與活力匯聚一堂。
dialogue.ja: 情熱とエネルギーが一つになります。
dialogue.local: Passion and energy come together.
dialogue.en: Passion and energy come together.

dialogue.text: The swimmers are put through their paces, carrying out the custom of Lead On winter swimming in Shaoxing.
dialogue.zh: 游泳者們接受鍛煉，遵循紹興立冬冬泳的習俗。
dialogue.ja: 泳ぐ人たちは練習を重ね、紹興の立冬冬泳の習慣を実践します。
dialogue.local: The swimmers are put through their paces, carrying out the custom of Lead On winter swimming in Shaoxing.
dialogue.en: The swimmers are put through their paces, carrying out the custom of Lead On winter swimming in Shaoxing.

dialogue.text: On the fifth day of winter, the annual National Winter Swimming Championships kicks off.
dialogue.zh: 冬季第五天，年度全國冬泳錦標賽開幕。
dialogue.ja: 冬の5日目に、毎年の全国冬泳選手権が始まります。
dialogue.local: On the fifth day of winter, the annual National Winter Swimming Championships kicks off.
dialogue.en: On the fifth day of winter, the annual National Winter Swimming Championships kicks off.

dialogue.text: From 18 to 69 years old, more than 3,500 could test from all over China, a year to participate in this winter swimming competition.
dialogue.zh: 來自全中國的3500多名18至69歲的選手每年參加這場冬泳比賽。
dialogue.ja: 18歳から69歳までの3500人以上が全国から集まり、この冬泳大会に参加します。
dialogue.local: From 18 to 69 years old, more than 3,500 could test from all over China, a year to participate in this winter swimming competition.
dialogue.en: From 18 to 69 years old, more than 3,500 could test from all over China, a year to participate in this winter swimming competition.

dialogue.text: Old Jin is bringing his team over, and they are looking very sportsman-like.
dialogue.zh: 老金帶著他的隊伍來了，他們看起來非常有運動精神。
dialogue.ja: 老金さんはチームを連れてきており、とてもスポーツマンらしいです。
dialogue.local: Old Jin is bringing his team over, and they are looking very sportsman-like.
dialogue.en: Old Jin is bringing his team over, and they are looking very sportsman-like.

dialogue.text: It's too warm, so in order to reach the required water temperature for racing, staff have put huge blocks of ice into the lanes one after another.
dialogue.zh: 天氣太暖和，為了達到比賽所需水溫，工作人員陸續放入大塊冰塊。
dialogue.ja: 暖かすぎるため、レースに必要な水温にするために、スタッフは次々と大きな氷の塊をコースに入れました。
dialogue.local: It's too warm, so in order to reach the required water temperature for racing, staff have put huge blocks of ice into the lanes one after another.
dialogue.en: It's too warm, so in order to reach the required water temperature for racing, staff have put huge blocks of ice into the lanes one after another.

dialogue.text: Everything's ready, and the race is about to begin.
dialogue.zh: 一切準備就緒，比賽即將開始。
dialogue.ja: すべて準備が整い、レースが始まろうとしています。
dialogue.local: Everything's ready, and the race is about to begin.
dialogue.en: Everything's ready, and the race is about to begin.

dialogue.text: It's not so much a race as a winter swimming site, the level of excitement is far more intense than it would just about the competition.
dialogue.zh: 這不僅是比賽，更像是一場冬泳盛會，興奮程度遠超比賽本身。
dialogue.ja: これは単なるレースというより冬泳の祭典であり、競技以上に興奮が高まっています。
dialogue.local: It's not so much a race as a winter swimming site, the level of excitement is far more intense than it would just about the competition.
dialogue.en: It's not so much a race as a winter swimming site, the level of excitement is far more intense than it would just about the competition.

dialogue.text: In China, there's simply far more water in the south than in the north, so it's easier to raise a swimmer, and it's easier to make a rich wine.
dialogue.zh: 在中國，南方水資源遠多於北方，因此更容易培養游泳者，也更容易釀造醇厚的酒。
dialogue.ja: 中国では南部の方が北部よりも水が豊富で、泳ぐ人を育てやすく、濃厚な酒を作りやすいです。
dialogue.local: In China, there's simply far more water in the south than in the north, so it's easier to raise a swimmer, and it's easier to make a rich wine.
dialogue.en: In China, there's simply far more water in the south than in the north, so it's easier to raise a swimmer, and it's easier to make a rich wine.

dialogue.text: Whether swimming or wine making, Lead On is a special time for both.
dialogue.zh: 無論是游泳還是釀酒，立冬對兩者來說都是特別的時刻。
dialogue.ja: 泳ぎでも醸造でも、立冬はどちらにとっても特別な時期です。
dialogue.local: Whether swimming or wine making, Lead On is a special time for both.
dialogue.en: Whether swimming or wine making, Lead On is a special time for both.

dialogue.text: It is the solar term that requires both hard work and patience to get what you want.
dialogue.zh: 這是一個需要努力和耐心才能收穫的節氣。
dialogue.ja: それは努力と忍耐が必要な節気です。
dialogue.local: It is the solar term that requires both hard work and patience to get what you want.
dialogue.en: It is the solar term that requires both hard work and patience to get what you want.
